include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/dll/devmgr)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# devmgmt.exe is all Rust (devmgmt-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/devmgmt-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# devmgmt.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/devmgmt-rust/src/devmgmt/devmgmt.rs)
add_cargo_module(devmgmt devmgmt-cargo devmgmt.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE devmgmt-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
